name: Pip

grow.label: GROWING KITTEN
grow.text: Grown up in 18 days. Kittens play more, nap more and have higher little voices.

hint: Hold a finger on Pip to pet. Short and gentle at first.

care.how: How it works. Feed about twice a day, at least four hours apart. A hungry cat tells you with its behavior, never with a notification. A cat that goes a very long time with no food will get weak, and about a week without food can be fatal.
care.bond: Bond. It grows from regular meals, gentle petting (3 a day count) and play (2 a day count). Strays are shy at first. Close friends greet you, follow your finger, rub against you and sometimes bring gifts.
care.vacationHint: Pauses hunger while you are away. Turn it off when you are back.
care.name: Pip

words.blinkHint: A slow blink is how cats say they feel safe

mind.text: Pip is calm. Still working out whether you are safe. Let him come to you.

likes.body: Cats pick their own spots. Time spent somewhere, and good moments there, slowly make a favorite. Toys you choose for him count a little more.
likes.noPlaces: No favorite places yet. Give it a day or two.

inner.body: How he feels about you is more than one number. Respecting his signals (ears back, a twitching tail) builds trust. Letting him come to you builds confidence.

quirks.name: Greeble spotter
quirks.text: He sometimes freezes and stares at absolutely nothing.

quirks.name: Dramatic flopper
quirks.text: He flops over sideways instead of sitting when he is very happy.

morph.title: Body shape
morph.intro: Proportions come from several genes each, so they vary smoothly and are passed on strongly. Breed two long-eared cats and their kittens tend to have long ears too. (Shown for the grown cat.)

dna.title: Genetics
dna.sub: Deep green eyes · about 4.1 kg as an adult (still growing).

rows.label: Sex
rows.text: The Y chromosome (SRY) makes a male.

rows.label: Tabby · TAQPEP · A1
rows.text: Pattern genes are present but hidden.

rows.label: White · KIT · B1
rows.text: Bicolor: about half white. The spotting grade comes from several modifier genes.

carries.rest: (hidden, can be passed on): dilute, long hair.

hidden.rest: Non-agouti hides the tabby pattern genes.
